round: The second narrowed round (the architect's Narrow decision recorded on #2161), at code head 70bc570bd7e6 (handoff e25512a4). Scope: whether the two findings of the review at 868cd58b are fixed, and whether the stored-block fix covers every refusal path that feeds the breaker (rules, charter revise, warn, unreadable).

keyFindings.description: Made by f1f55963. For an upload where nothing tells the stored blocks apart (an unchanged re-upload whose asks the stored version holds all, so the rules check returns undefined; a rules check that failed or judged none; or a failed read, asksPartial, even where the check judged the id-less openers, which are new by construction), a charter refusal counts WHOLE_CALL, while tripped() reads the upload's scan, which never holds WHOLE_CALL while the upload carries an ask. From the second refusal on, every refusal warns that the same call again goes out unreviewed, and every resend is refused again: the warning is false and the breaker never ends the loop. Reproduced in a scratch copy at e25512a4: an unchanged re-upload of brief.md holding only #window, charter revising, block mode, sent 4 times: all 4 refused, the warning on refusals 2-4; at 868cd58b the same probe sent the third on the breaker, as warned. Both thermonuclear reviews reproduced it and the asksPartial variants (PROBE11, PROBE12, DPROBE2). Fix, as the invariant: a refusal warns that a resend goes out unreviewed only when that resend will trip, so tripped() and refusalThings derive the same key set (WHOLE_CALL included) from one function; judged asks are counted whenever the check judged any, asksPartial or not.

Made by f1f55963. The breaker key is per tool and issue (BREAKER_KEYS has no document name), and the WHOLE_CALL counts above are exactly what an upload that opens no ask trips on (its scan is [WHOLE_CALL]). Two charter refusals of an unchanged brief.md upload on X-1, then any upload with no ask block on X-1 (another document, or the same text with its ask moved into prose), never refused: it goes out on the breaker without the charter review, and the agent is told 'Third attempt after two refusals of this call on its target', which is false. Both thermonuclear reviews reproduced it at 70bc570b (DPROBE, PROBE13: entries verdict/revise, verdict/revise, breaker/allow, 2 charter calls); with askgate-core.ts from 868cd58b the third upload is reviewed and refused. No new ask reaches a person through it, since the passed upload opens none, but a Dispatch write skips the review it was owed. Fix: the same one-function invariant; a key counted for an upload that carries asks must be one only that upload sent again can trip on.

fixesHold.stored_block_every_path: Holds in its aim and breaks the breaker's agreement: the only two breaker.revised calls are the rules refusal (counts the judged matches) and the charter revise (block mode counts refusalThings, warn mode counts nothing), and an unreadable call counts nothing, so no refusal counts a block an upload's stored version holds, and the new charter-path test fails with the old breakerThings(callAsks()) count restored (scratch mutation). Its WHOLE_CALL fallback for uploads makes the two findings above.
fixesHold.shutdown_in_flight_test: Holds: the new in-flight test fails with the shutdown cut made a no-op (scratch mutation: 0 pass, 1 fail) and passes at the head.
